canonical15_noThumbAA.purpose: tests whether the residual cross-dataset uncertainty in the thumb CMC ab/adduction axis materially drives posture identifiability

control_representations.policy: all three representations are reported side by side; none is used to select or tune the primary model, and the primary model choice is fixed at canonical16

frozen_protocol.normalization: train-only z-score, or none; never per-subject test centring
frozen_protocol.drift_method: per-subject rest-block median trajectory, offsets relative to the first rest block, linearly interpolated over normalised session time, subtracted; label-free
frozen_protocol.claim: Stable target postures are identifiable from canonical hand kinematics across unseen subjects. NOT a claim about continuous or streaming recognition.

evidence_tiers.A_primary_confirmatory: design item 2_untouched_confirmation.a_train_exposed_test_untouched -- train on the development-exposed cohort, test once on the outcome-unseen cohort. Strongest confirmatory evidence.
evidence_tiers.B_full_77_loso_descriptive: design item 1_full_77_loso -- full-corpus replication figure. Descriptive only: the development-exposed subjects are inside this evaluation.
evidence_tiers.C_secondary_confirmatory: design item 2_untouched_confirmation.b_loso_within_untouched -- LOSO inside the outcome-unseen cohort. Cohort peers are in every training fold, so this is not an untouched external holdout.
evidence_tiers.rule: A is the primary number; B and C are reported alongside it and may never be substituted for it. All three are computed with the same frozen model, representation and metrics.

protocol.statistic: median over the central third of each labelled repetition

movement_names.2: Extension of index and middle, flexion of the others
movement_names.3: Flexion of ring and little finger, extension of the others
movement_names.4: Thumb opposing base of little finger

primary_confirmatory.tier: A: PRIMARY CONFIRMATORY -- one-shot external holdout
primary_confirmatory.selection_rule: configuration fixed by pre-registration; never selected from evaluation scores

full_77_loso_descriptive.tier: B: full-corpus descriptive evidence (NOT the primary confirmatory arm -- the development-exposed subjects are included in this evaluation)
full_77_loso_descriptive.selection_rule: frozen configuration returned by identity; never selected from evaluation scores

secondary_confirmatory.tier: C: secondary confirmatory -- LOSO within the outcome-unseen cohort; cohort peers participate in training in every fold, so this is NOT an untouched external holdout

A_primary_confirmatory.may_be_cited_as: the primary confirmatory evidence for posture identifiability across unseen subjects
A_primary_confirmatory.may_not_be_cited_as: a full-corpus figure; its test subjects are only the outcome-unseen cohort

B_full_77_loso_descriptive.may_not_be_cited_as: the primary confirmatory result; the development-exposed subjects are inside this evaluation

evidence_tiers.ordering_rule: A is the strongest evidence; B and C are supportive and are never substituted for A

_meta.tier: C: secondary/exploratory comparison -- source-database transfer. NOT the primary confirmatory arm.
_meta.note: held-out source database subjects are not the primary confirmatory test set; this is reported alongside arm A and is never substituted for it

_meta.tier: C: secondary/exploratory comparison -- pre-registered representation controls on the full-77 LOSO corpus. NOT the primary confirmatory arm.
_meta.note: the primary confirmatory number is produced by arm A with canonical16 only; these controls are reported alongside it and never substituted for it

representation_controls_policy: canonical16 is the primary representation and its model is fixed. The two control representations are REPORTED ONLY and were pre-registered; no model, hyperparameter or representation was selected using them.

dip_control._tier: C: secondary/exploratory comparison -- pre-registered representation controls on the full-77 LOSO corpus. NOT the primary confirmatory arm.

validity.evidence_tier: supporting control only; NOT the primary confirmatory arm, and never substituted for it
why_not_leakage_free: drift-corrected uses a trajectory estimated from the held-out subject's own rest samples (a test-subject-derived statistic)
drift-only locates measurement time using the true movement label
validity.may_be_cited_as: an upper bound on how much a session-time shortcut could explain
validity.may_not_be_cited_as: a deployment-valid or leakage-free control, or as support for the primary result

primary_confirmatory.tier: A: PRIMARY CONFIRMATORY -- one-shot external holdout (train on development-exposed, test on outcome-unseen)
